rules.statement: In a case involving a hypothecary decree, directing that the mortgaged property be sold by a named auctioneer, no order for sale with notice to the judgment-debtor under Section 347 of the Civil Procedure Code is necessary.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am of opinion that, in a case involving a hypothecary decree, directing that the mortgaged property be sold by a named auctioneer, no order for sale with notice to the judgment-debtor under-section 347 of the Civil Procedure Code is necessary."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 347 of the Civil Procedure Code
